name: Fingerprint Grow → On Enrollment Failed
description:
An action to be performed when a fingerprint enrollment failed. See [`on_enrollment_failed` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow/#fingerprint_grow-on_enrollment_failed).

With this configuration option you can write complex automations whenever a finger failed to be enrolled. To use the variables, use a [lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates/#config-lambda) template, the slot number that failed to be enrolled into is available inside that lambda under the variable named `finger_id`.
